title: Exact stored movement counts
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Boolean Turing machine, let $C,e,c,A,d$ be natural numbers, and let $x$ be a Boolean word. For every cursor $j$, every time $t$ at most $c\bigl(A(|x|+C(|x|+1)^e+1)^d+1\bigr)^2$, and every movement-count coordinate $i$, the count stored at time $t$ in the packed word formed from $M,C,e,c,A,d,x,j$ equals the count specified by the trajectory of $M$ on the all-false word of length $|x|+C(|x|+1)^e$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Boolean Turing machine
$t$ is at most the stated producer horizon
replaced: For every source machine, parameters, instance $x$, cursor $j$, time $t$ at most the producer horizon, and coordinate $i$, the stored count read from the body word equals the canonical movement count at time $t$ over the all-false reference input; the bound never truncates valid data.
